title: Layerwise quant anchor-case harness with adaptive acceptance thresholds
creator: Priya Desai
description: Build an automated validation harness that runs layerwise quantized variants (FP8/INT8) against a curated set of anchor-cases spanning short/long/contextual prompts. The harness will compute semantic and distributional metrics, apply adaptive acceptance thresholds derived from historical baselines, and surface deterministic pass/fail signals that can be used as CI gates for quant rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Harness runs reproducibly in CI and on the nightly validation cluster with deterministic seeds and captured RNG state.
Three anchor cohorts (short-interactive, long-context, instruction-heavy) are defined with 500 unique prompts each and stored as immutable anchor-case artifacts.
Metrics produced per run: S-BERT cosine, token distribution KL divergence, response length delta, and task-specific top-1 match where applicable.

Adaptive threshold algorithm implemented: baseline mean +/- 2 sigma with an absolute floor. A run fails if metric degradation exceeds both relative and absolute thresholds (e.g., S-BERT drop > 0.02 AND absolute < 0.90).
CI integration: PRs that change quant profile or model weights trigger the harness; any failing gate blocks merge and annotates PR with metric diffs and top-k failing anchor cases.
Run metadata is emitted to telemetry with tags: model_version, quant_profile, calibration_seed, layer_mask, run_id.
Operational runbook exists for investigating failures and rolling back quant profiles in Dedicated/Private deployments.
implementation_notes: Layerwise validation: run a sweep where quantization is applied to contiguous layer groups (e.g., embed+first-N, middle blocks, final blocks) to identify sensitivity hotspots.
Adaptive thresholds: maintain a rolling baseline computed from last 30 successful nightly runs; use bootstrap to estimate confidence intervals for non-normal metrics.
Determinism: run sampling at temperature=0 for gating where applicable; for sampling-based tasks provide parallel stochastic checks (n=5) and use median S-BERT to avoid single-run noise.
Calibration integration: after each calibrate job, attach calibration_seed and calibration_stats artifact to run for reproducibility.
Failure triage: first-level triage script auto-collects top-20 anchor-cases with largest metric delta and uploads diffs and raw model outputs to a diagnostic bucket.
Compute: prioritize using nightly Dedicated pool with consistent GPU type to reduce hardware variance; annotate runs with hardware fingerprint.
test_results: Baseline (float32) on anchor-cohort A: S-BERT mean=0.942, KL(token)=0.0018, median response len=34
INT8 (layerwise middle blocks quantized) on cohort A: S-BERT mean=0.937 (-0.005), KL=0.0024 (+0.0006) -> within adaptive threshold (pass)
FP8 (aggressive per-layer config) on cohort B: S-BERT mean=0.885 (-0.06) -> triggers hard-fail (semantic regression) and flagged for immediate follow-up
Stochastic check (sampling tasks) with 5 seeds: median S-BERT reduction 0.008 vs baseline; max single-seed drop 0.03 -> stochastic outlier detected, requires longer evaluation.
